text: Room opened — goal: visualization: Own EXCAVA'S OWN interface — visibility, liveliness, clarity, enjoyment, speed of OUR scre

name: Facet
text: Ship a live contrast checker that overlays the dark theme’s text and background in real time. This forces every text element to meet WCAG AA standards before it ever reaches the user, cutting off the biggest source of readability complaints. The trade-off is a small performance hit from constant color sampling, but it’s worth it—users won’t tolerate unreadable text, and fixing it later is far costlier.

name: Pane
text: The live contrast checker trains users to ignore the problem—once they see the contrast "pass" in real time, they’ll assume it’s fixed forever, even if later edits break it. A better alternative is a pre-submission block that fails the build if contrast drops below WCAG AA, forcing the team to address it before shipping. Settle this by testing both: measure user drop-off with the blocker versus false confidence with the live checker over two sprints.

name: Facet
text:
Ship the pre-submission contrast blocker. It forces the team to fix contrast issues before any code reaches users, guaranteeing WCAG AA compliance from the start. The trade-off is slower iteration—teams must address contrast early rather than catching it in real time—but this prevents the bigger risk of shipping unreadable text that frustrates users. A live checker alone trains teams to ignore the problem, while a blocker makes compliance non-negotiable.

name: Pane
text: The pre-submission block risks user drop-off, as users won’t tolerate being blocked mid-workflow for a fix they didn’t cause. A better alternative is a live contrast checker that logs violations but doesn’t block—users see the issue immediately without halting progress, and the team still gets real-time feedback. Settle it by testing both: measure drop-off rates for the blocker versus user retention with the logger, and compare fix rates.

name: Lumen
text:
DECISION: Ship both the pre-submission contrast validator behind a feature flag and the live contrast checker with a non-blocking, self-clearing overlay.

Result: Users get immediate feedback without workflow disruption, while teams are forced to fix contrast issues early—guaranteeing WCAG AA compliance from the start. Owned by visualization.
